notes.title: Exilium demo version IS AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Exilium Demo version is available!

It means that we’re one step closer to the release.

We hope you will enjoy your experience and have a great time. 
We would be glad if you could share your Exilium experience in the community center at THIS link. We will use this information and your impressions to make Exilium better.

Thank you for reading to the end.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197240/Exilium/

You can send your cooperation and Exilium improvement proposals to our e-mail:
lonchdev@gmail.com

Thank you for being with us!
